zoe: noticed some backups with KMS wrap metadata pointing at cryptoKeyVersions/4 in gs://redwood-backups/legacy-secrets/. No plaintext. Flagging because v4 predates our CI rotation.
omar: paste sample object?
zoe: legacy-db-creds-20250214.wrap (metadata: projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/legacy-kek/cryptoKeyVersions/4)
leo: if v4 still enabled -> revoke bindings, create new key version, rewrap.
vaultbot: Note: some entries were double-encrypted (vault transit -> kms wrap). Coordinate with vault team before rewrap.
zoe: proposed immediate steps: 1) snapshot flagged objects to quarantine bucket, 2) run audit for CryptoKeyDecrypt on v4 for last 365d, 3) remove deprecated service accounts from KEK binding, 4) rewrap to new version, 5) validate Vault unwraps.
omar: I can copy to quarantine and record checksums. Doing now.
leo: I will prepare IAM change PR to remove old-runner SA from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.
vaultbot: Assigned: @omar -> quarantine copy + checksums, @leo -> IAM PR, @zoe -> audit sweep + post-check.
zoe: Quick audit query I ran showed two decrypt operations in Jan by runner@redwood-ci. Flagging to eng-sre to confirm legitimacy.
omar: quarantine copy done (12 objects). Checksums logged in infra-ticket.
leo: IAM PR created infra/infra-iam#701, requesting review.
zoe: once IAM PR merges we should disable v4 (not destroy) and run rewrap dry-run on a staging copy.
leo: agreed. Scheduling 45m maintenance window tomorrow 02:15 UTC for rewrap and vault transit rotation.
zoe: adding rollback: restore pointer to original objects from quarantine and re-enable v4 if needed.
vaultbot: Closing loop pending PR merge and audit confirmation.
